ownership.quote: Bytebot is the open source container for AI desktop agents. Founded in 2021 by Carl Atupem, Bytebot has 3 employees based in Boston.

stage.note: YC's company page lists Bytebot's batch as Summer 2021 and current status as 'Acquired', but no acquirer, date, deal terms, or any priced equity round (seed/Series A/etc.) is disclosed anywhere found. No TechCrunch/Crunchbase/press coverage of a Bytebot funding round or acquisition turned up in web, Bing, or HN searches. The company's own GitHub repo (bytebot-ai/bytebot) was archived (made read-only) by the owner on 2026-03-07, consistent with the company having been acquired/wound down, but that alone doesn't confirm terms or acquirer.

note: YC company page (batch Summer 2021, founder Carl Atupem, Boston) shares the bytebot.ai domain confirmed on the card's own sources, and its description matches the current open-source AI desktop-agent product ('Bytebot is the open source container for AI desktop agents'), so this is the same company, not a different 'Bytebot'. YC lists its status as 'Acquired' but does not name an acquirer or date; the bytebot-ai/bytebot GitHub repo was archived (owner made it read-only) on 2026-03-07, and the marketing site/docs remain online. No funding round, investor, or revenue figure for Bytebot could be confirmed or even estimated from any source reachable in this session (Crunchbase and LinkedIn company pages both blocked login walls/403; DuckDuckGo and Bing searches for funding/acquisition terms returned no results).
